tasks.short: Provide professional architectural consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Clarify the consulting question and client's constraints
Read project documents relevant to the consulting question
Develop professional recommendations and record their supporting reasoning

loop.purpose: Express the teacher's recommendations in an advice draft
loop.input: Recommendation notes and permitted supporting project sources
loop.check: Teacher checks that recommendations, conditions and uncertainty match the notes and project evidence
loop.stop: One correction then manual writing of unsupported or materially altered advice
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed report template cannot express the project-specific reasoning

steps.what: Discuss professional advice and resolve the client's questions
Revise the consulting document after discussion
Send the final professional advice to the client

tasks.design: Use a bounded drafting aid in {DOCS} to express the teacher's recommendations from selected project evidence. The teacher handles consulting discussions and revisions, then checks and sends the final advice through {EMAIL} as a separate action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a report repeats reasoning already developed in recommendation notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can turn those notes into an editable professional document.
tasks.still_hard: Project context, professional liability and conflicting client objectives require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher chooses defensible advice and explains its limitations to the client.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in report prose; professional responsibility and client contact remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain the technical limits of a design recommendation
reach.learn: Consulting scope and evidence-based professional advice

evidence.claim: A model can draft an advice document from expert notes with source checking; consulting quality and the labour estimate are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes scope discussions, evidence reading, recommendation notes, report writing, client discussion, final revision and actual send. The scenario assumes a written advice deliverable, not purely oral consulting.

The teacher produces recommendation, rationale, evidence location and limitation fields in s3; capture time is retained. Client documents arrive through the existing engagement; no extra supplier transcription is assumed.
Missing evidence or unclear recommendations returns to manual report writing. No structured risk code or client-ready advice is assumed as a free input.

Test native report templates and reusable standard sections before a loop. The send gate covers the post-discussion final version, recipient and attachments; internal saves have no approval or saving.
unknowns: Whether this consulting work normally has a written deliverable
research_questions: Does checked drafting preserve the expert's conditions and limitations in the delivered advice?

already_counted.description: Recommendation capture, draft correction, final revision and send checks remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain permitted source handling and inspect drafting failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final advice version after s6, attachments and client recipients checked in s7; changes void the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R92, gross8 minus3 upkeep gives net5. Range0-2 assumes written reports from explicit recommendations; oral-only engagements gain nothing from this design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Read campus and community event details and participation requirements
Plan the teacher's contribution to the event
Confirm participation and the agreed contribution with the event organiser
Prepare contribution notes for the campus or community event
Participate in campus and community event activities and conversations

tasks.design: Use the native linked invitation view in {CALENDAR} to find event details and a reusable contribution-note structure in {DOCS}. The teacher plans the contribution, confirms it with the organiser and participates in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event details and earlier contribution notes are scattered across messages and documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native event links and document templates can shorten lookup and repeated note structure.
tasks.still_hard: A useful contribution depends on the event and the people present.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher builds relationships and responds to community interests.
tasks.altitude: Participation stays personal; small preparation fragments become shorter.

reach.task: Adapt a public activity to community interests

evidence.claim: Native calendar links and reusable note structures can reduce repeated event preparation; the scenario and time estimate are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary includes participation planning, confirmation, contribution notes and attendance. The scenario is an invited contribution with short preparation, rather than simple attendance.

The event organiser produces title, date, time, location, contact and requested contribution in the existing invitation. No new structured input is demanded from the organiser; the teacher reads and clarifies missing fields within s1 and s2.
The teacher writes the participation plan in s2 and actual contribution content in s4. A template touches headings and reuse only, not the contribution decision or live participation.
Test native calendar invitation links and document reuse first. Missing event details require manual lookup or clarification. Internal note saves earn no saving or self-gate.
The external-organiser scenario uses a final-version confirmation gate. If the organiser is internal, authority becomes write_internal and the actual message remains a distinct step.
unknowns: Whether the teacher prepares a contribution or simply attends
How well invitations and prior notes are already linked
research_questions: Does native linking shorten lookup after all manual clarification is counted?

already_counted.description: Planning, confirmation checks and contribution writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Keep the small contribution-note structure and event links usable.

approvals.approved_version: Exact contribution commitment, event date and organiser recipient checked before sending s3; any change requires recheck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100, R96, gross4 minus1 upkeep gives net3. Range0-1 assumes linked invitations and reusable contribution notes save some preparation; attendance and conversations retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Professional consulting and community relationships stay human while selected document preparation becomes shorter.
reach: Exchange technical consulting methods with engineering teachers
Adapt public contributions with self-enrichment teachers
role.ambitious_version: An architecture teacher who can give careful professional advice and participate in community events with less repeated document work.
